insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual: 1L to 50L (by variant). Family Floater: 2L to 50L (by variant).

great.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus (non-resetting): 10% each year irrespective of claims (up to 100%)
great.quote: “On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims... The maximum multiplier bonus will not exceed 100% of the Basic Sum Insured in any Policy Year.”
great.explanation: This is strong because the bonus accrues even if you make claims (unlike typical NCB that reduces/resets after claims).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: “30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Standard industry waiting period for non-accidental illnesses in the first 30 days.

good.name: Specific illness / procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: “Specified disease/procedure waiting period... excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.”

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.”
good.explanation: 3 years is within normal market range for many policies (not a red flag).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: up to 60 days
good.quote: “Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission to the Hospital”
good.explanation: Covers diagnostic/consultation/medicines related to the same hospitalization up to 60 days prior.

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: up to 90 days
good.quote: “Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 90 days after discharge from Hospitalisation”
good.explanation: Covers follow-up expenses for 90 days post discharge (within standard range).

bad.name: No restore benefit (sum insured is NOT replenished after a claim)
bad.quote: No clause found in provided wording for restoration/reinstatement/reload of Sum Insured after a claim.
bad.reference: Not mentioned in the provided sections
bad.explanation: If you exhaust the base sum insured in a year, the policy (as per this wording extract) does not state any automatic refill for subsequent claims in the same year.

bad.name: Consumables not covered (listed non-payables like gloves, masks, kits etc.)
bad.quote: “Annexure I - List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy” (includes) “GLOVES”, “MASK”, “NEBULISATION KIT”, “ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]”
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables are payable by you, increasing out-of-pocket costs even for cashless claims.

unclear.name: Room rent limit / room category eligibility
unclear.quote: “Room Rent means the amount charged by a hospital towards room and boarding expenses and shall include associated medical expenses.”
unclear.explanation: The extract does not specify the allowed room type/limit (Any room / Single AC / shared / etc.). Check your policy schedule/plan variant terms for room eligibility because it can affect claim deductions.

unclear.name: Co-pay (co-payment) applicability
unclear.quote: “Co-payment means a cost-sharing requirement... the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount.”
unclear.explanation: Co-pay is defined but the extract does not confirm whether it applies, and if yes, the percentage/age triggers. Verify in schedule/endorsements.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
